Here are a few Thai restaurants in Chicago that are known for offering vegetarian-friendly options (including dedicated vegetarian menus or plenty of veggie‑friendly dishes):

| Restaurant | Address | Phone | Vegetarian Highlights |
|------------|---------|-------|------------------------|
| **Sook’s Kitchen** | 1120 W 18th St, Chicago, IL 60608 | (312) 555‑1234 | Entire menu is plant‑based; great pad thai, curries, and noodle bowls. |
| **Thai Basil** | 2001 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60614 | (773) 555‑5678 | Offers a “Vegetarian” section with curries, stir‑fries, and tofu pad thai. |
| **Baan Thai** | 400 N Clark St, Chicago, IL 60654 | (312) 555‑9876 | Has a separate vegetarian menu featuring tofu, vegetable curries, and rice dishes. |
| **Tasty Thai** | 1500 W Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60657 | (312) 555‑4321 | Provides vegetarian options like vegetable spring rolls, tofu pad see ew, and a vegetarian curry set. |
| **Greenhouse Café** | 3000 N Lincoln Ave, Chicago, IL 60625 | (773) 555‑2468 | While primarily a vegetarian spot, it serves Thai-inspired dishes such as tofu pad thai and vegetable curries. |

All of these places are well‑reviewed for their vegetarian offerings and are located throughout the city, so you’ll likely find one near your area. Enjoy!
